title: Fire Stopping – Penetration Seals
activity: Batts, sealant joints, collars and wraps
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Corridor wall E1, riser R2

questions.q: Seal matches the benchmark for this seal type?
Are service-to-service and service-to-edge spacings within the CLM table? Use the Spacing guide.
Are services clear of the 200 mm door head zone and the critical stud zones?
Is the seal type right for the opening (FSI tight to soffit, Quelfire where services are ≥100 mm below soffit)?
Ask the fitter: Which system is this (FSi or Quelfire), and what sleeve/wrap does this service need? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Is the batt tight around every service and sealed on both sides, with no gaps?
Are sealant joints to depth (2:1 ratio) and within tested width limits?
Collar or wrap matches the CLM schedule for this pipe (size, material, insulation)?
Gas pipe through the seal: insulation to the system (FSi 50 mm stone wool / Quelfire 40 mm 45 kg/m³ for 500 mm), ≥80 mm to cast iron and sprinklers in Quelfire, sleeved, gas specialist happy?
questions.source: CLM schedule SH-X-00003 C00; CLM Golden Rules K; BS 6891

questions.q: CLM operative on site has their FIRAS card?

notOk.t: Penetration left unsealed, or sealed but not labelled / photographed
Pipe or tray support more than 400 mm from the seal (both sides)
Fire stopping damaged by later trades (extra cables pushed through) and not re-made
Gaps around back boxes in fire-rated walls (no putty pad)
Deflection head fire stopping incomplete or deteriorating
Services too close together / to the edge for the tested spacing
Unistrut or studs built into the seal
